description:
This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

WWII Finn loses a foot to a mine, survives a booby trap, eats a raw Siberian jay, and lasts days in a −30°C minefield. Aimo Koivunen was rescued at 43 kg with a heart rate of 200. True story.
What other extreme survival story should we do next?
